_note: Caves and dungeons. rooms = rooms before the guardian. monsters = groups for fight rooms; boss = the guardian's group. dc = difficulty class of trap/chest/shrine checks. reward goes to cargo when the guardian falls; flag dungeon_done_<id> is set.

crystal_cave.name: Crystal cave
crystal_cave.intro: Light glints off a thousand crystals. Something skitters further in, and kobold paint marks the walls: KEEP OUT.

old_crypt.name: Old crypt
old_crypt.intro: Stone steps under a broken chapel lead down into cold air. The dead here were buried with their swords. Not all of them stayed buried.

sunken_fort.name: Sunken fort
sunken_fort.intro: A fortress half swallowed by the sea. Pirates, gnolls and worse share its flooded halls, and the drums of a troll king echo below.
